newsitem.title: USA: PP&L shuts Pa. nuke for 5-week maintenance.
newsitem.headline: PP&L shuts Pa. nuke for 5-week maintenance.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power and Light Co said Monday its 1,090 megawatt (MW) Susquehanna unit 1 was shut down Saturday to begin a refueling and maintenance outage.
The Berwick, Pa., plant is expected to be out of service for about five weeks.
About 30 percent of the unit's uranium fuel will be replaced, company spokesman Herbert Woodeshick said in a statement.
Maintenance also involves the inspection of one of its three low-pressure turbines and the ultrasonic testing of the turbine's 14 sets of rotor blades, he said.
The Susquehanna plant is jointly owned by PP&L and Allegheny Electric Cooperative Inc.
